knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`, Splunkbase 3088) with the modular input for `google:gcp:billing:report`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.3.41.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable BigQuery billing export; ingest billing table via GCP add-on or HEC.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:billing:report" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:billing:report"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.3.74_gcp_billing_export_cost_74"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:billing:report` in `index=gcp` to detect gcp billing export cost anomaly. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_3_74_alert` with severity aligned to `medium` criticality. Dashboard: Daily cost timechart, top services, anomaly single value..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`, Splunkbase 3088) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
